mapper.select: SELECT id, title, single_select + 0 AS singleSelect, required + 0 AS required, enabled + 0 AS enabled, sort_no AS sortNo FROM im_onboarding_prompt WHERE guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND guild_id = #{guildId} ORDER BY sort_no, id

SELECT o.id, o.prompt_id AS promptId, o.label, o.description, o.emoji, o.sort_no AS sortNo FROM im_onboarding_option o JOIN im_onboarding_prompt p ON p.id = o.prompt_id WHERE p.guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND p.guild_id = #{guildId} ORDER BY o.prompt_id, o.sort_no, o.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO im_onboarding_prompt(guild_kind, guild_id, title, single_select, required, enabled, sort_no) VALUES (#{guildKind}, #{guildId}, #{title}, #{singleSelect}, #{required}, 1, #{sortNo})
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM im_onboarding_prompt WHERE guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND guild_id = #{guildId} AND sort_no = #{sortNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO im_onboarding_option(prompt_id, label, description, emoji, sort_no) VALUES (#{promptId}, #{label}, #{description}, #{emoji}, #{sortNo})
mapper.select: SELECT configuration_hash AS configurationHash, answers_json AS answers, request_id AS requestId FROM im_onboarding_answer WHERE guild_kind = #{guildKind} AND guild_id = #{guildId} AND member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO im_onboarding_answer(guild_kind, guild_id, member_id, configuration_hash, answers_json, request_id) VALUES (#{guildKind}, #{guildId}, #{memberId}, #{hash}, #{answers}, #{requestId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE configuration_hash = VALUES(configuration_hash), answers_json = VALUES(answers_json), request_id = VALUES(request_id)
